criteria_note: smoke-good-2b/3c/2d/3e resolved INCONCLUSIVE (terminal, kept as on-chain history): their translations RESTRUCTURE sentences, and criterion 0 (preserve every number) can only PASS with one translation-quote citation demonstrating it; no single span carries all numbers, so the model conservatively answered UNCERTAIN. INCONCLUSIVE is the designed fail-safe: unproven never certifies.
